subject: gk
question: Who has become the new chief of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subodh Kumar Jaiswal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subodh Kumar Jaiswal**__ is an Indian police officer.

 __
 
• He is currently serving as the director of the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI).**
 
• **He was appointed as the chief of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) in January 2021**__.
 __
 
• He was the 28th chief of the force at the CISF.
 
 
 
• He served as the additional secretary of R&AW for three years.
 
• He is set to retire from service in September 2022.
 
• He has previously worked with the PM's Special Protection Group and RAW.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• As of November 2021, **Sheel Vardhan Singh** is the new chief of the Central Industrial Security Force.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As of January 2021, **Rajat Datta** is the new director-general of the Armed Forces Medical Services.
 
• **Kumar Rajesh Chandra** was appointed as Director-General of Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) in January 2019.
 
• **Pankaj Kumar Singh** was appointed as the director-general (DG) of the Border Security Force (BSF) in August 2021.
